prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1191; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the accident you reported involving your vehicle in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was making a left turn at an intersection with a traffic light. The light had turned yellow and I was trying to get through before it changed. Another vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you the one turning left, or were you going straight?

A: I was turning left. I had already started into the turn when the other car hit me.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They said they didn't see me coming. They seemed shaken up, but they were willing to exchange information.

Q: Were you hurt in the collision?

A: Yes. My neck was sore right away, and by the next morning I had stiffness and some pain when I turned my head to the left. I went to get checked out and was told I had a neck strain.

Q: Have you been receiving any treatment since then?

A: I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor said it should improve over the next several weeks.

Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness in your neck before this accident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I'd never had any real problems with my neck.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: I don't think so. I've given you everything I remember. I'd just like to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
